up: Retrieve the first 1000 rows of exact IC50 activities (standard relation '=') with non‑null pChEMBL values for human (organism = Homo sapiens) single‑protein targets whose target ChEMBL ID is CHEMBL1881 (Prostaglandin E2 receptor EP2 subtype). Return assay ChEMBL ID, target type (target_dictionary.target_type), taxonomy ID (target_dictionary.tax_id), canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles), molecule ChEMBL ID (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), standard type (activities.standard_type), and pChEMBL value (activities.pchembl_value). Order the result set by molecule ChEMBL ID (ascending) and assay ChEMBL ID (ascending).
sql:
SELECT
  DISTINCT ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
  td.target_type,
  td.tax_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  a.standard_type,
  a.pchembl_value
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molecule_chembl_id = md.chembl_id
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molecule_chembl_id = cs.molecule_chembl_id
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1881'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
  AND md.max_phase = 4
  AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'
ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC, ass.chembl_id ASC
LIMIT 1000;

sql:
WITH filtered_activities AS (
  SELECT a.assay_id, a.molregno, a.pchembl_value, a.standard_type
  FROM activities a
  JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
  JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
  WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1881'
    AND a.standard_relation = '='
    AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'
    AND td.tax_id = 9606
    AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
    AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
  GROUP BY a.assay_id, a.molregno, a.pchembl_value, a.standard_type
  HAVING COUNT(*) = 1
)
SELECT DISTINCT ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
       td.target_type,
       td.tax_id,
       cs.canonical_smiles,
       md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
       fa.standard_type,
       fa.pchembl_value
FROM filtered_activities fa
JOIN activities a ON fa.assay_id = a.assay_id AND fa.molregno = a.molregno
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molecule_chembl_id
WHERE a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC, ass.chembl_id ASC
LIMIT 1000;
